footer.tagline: A Sri Lankan digital bank for loans, vehicle leasing and currency exchange — with the reasoning behind every credit decision shown to the person it affects.
footer.fdicBadge: Served in Sinhala, Tamil and English

home.heroSubtitle: Personal and business loans, vehicle leasing under the Finance Leasing Act, and multi-currency exchange. Every credit decision arrives with the reasons behind it — not just a yes or a no.
home.boardDisclaimer: Indicative annual rates, read live from our product catalogue. Your rate depends on your assessment — better applications price lower.
home.productsTitle: Three ways to move money, one account.
home.productsIntro: Apply once. Your profile, documents and verification carry across all three, so the second application asks far less than the first.
home.loansBody: Personal, housing, education, business and pawning. Fixed or reducing balance, with the full repayment schedule shown before you commit.
home.leaseBody: Cars, vans, motorcycles, three-wheelers and commercial vehicles. We buy the vehicle from an approved dealer; you pay monthly rentals.
home.fxBody: Buy and sell major currencies at rates published on the board, with a receipt and a record for every transaction you make.
home.decisionTitle: Five steps, and you can see all of them.
home.decisionIntro: Most lenders return a verdict and keep the reasoning. We show the sequence, and if you are declined we tell you which factors weighed against you and what would change the answer.
home.decisionHuman: A model scores your application. It does not approve it. Every decision is confirmed by a credit officer, and the officer's name is on the record.
home.stepApplyDesc: Income, employment and commitments, plus your documents. Drafts save as you go, so a long form can be finished later.
home.stepScoreDesc: A risk model reads your profile and returns a score with the factors that drove it — kept as a snapshot, so the reasoning survives the decision.
home.stepPolicyDesc: Affordability, debt-to-income, age, tenure and loan-to-value are checked as explicit rules. Each one passes or fails on its own and says why.
home.stepReviewDesc: A person reads the file, the score and the policy result, then decides. They can approve on different terms, ask for more, or decline with a reason.
home.stepOfferDesc: Amount, rate, term, monthly instalment, fees and the full schedule — in writing, before you accept anything.
home.leaseSpotTitle: A lease is not a car loan.
home.leaseSpotBody: Under the Finance Leasing Act we buy the vehicle and remain its absolute owner while you use it. You are the registered user from day one, and ownership transfers to you after the final rental. That is a different instrument from a loan secured against a car, and we treat it as one.
home.titleStartDesc: You pay a down payment. We pay the dealer and register the vehicle with the DMT — us as absolute owner, you as registered user.
home.titleDuringDesc: You hold and use the vehicle and pay monthly rentals. Settle early and the unearned interest is rebated.
home.titleEndDesc: The final rental clears, we issue a letter of release, and the DMT transfers absolute ownership to you.
home.langTitle: In the language you actually bank in.
home.langBody: The customer side of this bank runs in Sinhala, Tamil and English. Switch at any time — your application, your schedule and your documents follow you.
home.ctaSubtitle: A short eligibility check tells you the likely amount, rate and monthly instalment before you make a formal application.
home.ctaFootnote: No effect on your credit record. Takes about five minutes.

about.objectivesTitle: The Three Core Pillars of Degital
about.pageSubtitle: Learn more about the project goals, core mathematical objectives, technological stack, and researchers behind this modern underwriting SaaS simulator.
about.genesisPara1: The traditional financial apparatus evaluates risk using methods created in the mid-20th century. Standard credit reports represent historical payments but fail to capture real-time financial trajectory or asset stability.
about.genesisPara2: Degital AI Loan System is a simulation built to showcase the feasibility of decentralized, automated credit assessments. By integrating secure document handling and alternative cashflow modeling, Degital predicts debt-to-income sustainability in real-time, removing biases and streamlining officer review queues.
about.blueprintQuote: "Our simulation bridges user-submitted data with algorithmic rate-setting, proving that digital automation can slash application assessment latencies from weeks to under five seconds safely."
about.objectiveAccuracyDesc: Move past static 3-digit legacy scores by predicting default probability with multiple concurrent data variables.
about.objectiveAccessDesc: Establish alternative paths to credit for self-employed individuals, creators, and micro-entrepreneurs.
about.objectivePrivacyDesc: Verify financial files dynamically through client-redacted server pipelines, maintaining strict bank compliance.
about.stackFrontend2: Tailwind CSS Utility architecture with custom banking theme
about.stackFrontend3: Lucide React clean design svg iconography
about.stackFrontend4: Framer Motion / Motion engine for fluid transitions
about.stackAi1: Deep reinforcement neural networks for rate optimization
about.stackAi2: Encrypted document storage with staff-reviewed verification
about.stackAi3: Metadata verification & document tamper detection scoring
about.stackAi4: Large language model (LLM) legal text translation pipelines
about.stackData3: Mock backend safety logs displaying raw underwriting telemetry
about.stackData4: Compliance sandboxing mapped for demonstration purposes
about.teamBio1: Former MIT AI Lab lead developer. Evelyn designs our underlying credit risk scoring neural networks and automated evaluation engines.
about.teamBio2: Over 15 years securing banking applications. Marcus ensures our document handling and predictive analysis architectures remain military-grade secure.
about.teamBio3: Experienced quantitative analyst. Siddharth structures our loan profiles, mathematical models, and predictive eligibility formulas.

servicesPage.pageSubtitle: A complete look at what you can do here — apply for a loan, lease a vehicle, exchange currency, and get AI-assisted guidance along the way.
servicesPage.loanProductsDesc: Five loan types to choose from — Personal, Housing, Education, Business, and Pawning — each with clear rates and terms shown upfront.
servicesPage.riskAssessmentDesc: We assess every application using your income, employment, and credit history to give you a clear Low, Medium, or High risk result in seconds.
servicesPage.smartRecommendationsDesc: Based on your risk result, we recommend a loan amount, type, and repayment plan sized to what you can comfortably afford.
servicesPage.aiExplanationDesc: Every risk result comes with a short, easy-to-understand explanation of the main factors behind it — in English, Sinhala, or Tamil.
servicesPage.fxExchangeDesc: Get a live quote, see your transaction limits and any document requirements upfront, then submit and track your request online. Once approved, print a settlement slip to complete it at a branch.
servicesPage.currencyRatesDesc: Real-time buy/sell exchange rates, historical rate charts, and a volatility outlook — always clearly marked as context, never a price prediction.
servicesPage.emiCalculatorDesc: Estimate your monthly loan installment instantly — no sign-in needed.
servicesPage.eligibilityDesc: Get a quick sense of your loan eligibility. Sign in for a full, live assessment.
servicesPage.supportDesc: Message our team directly from your account and track every reply in one place.
servicesPage.multilingualDesc: Use the entire site in English, Sinhala, or Tamil — switch anytime from the navigation bar.
servicesPage.complianceBody: This page describes the services available in this application. No real personal or financial data is processed — every result shown is for demonstration purposes only.
servicesPage.leasingProductsDesc: Cars, vans and SUVs, motorcycles, three-wheelers and commercial vehicles. We buy the vehicle and remain its owner until the final rental; you register and drive it from day one.

customer.hint: You can pay the next one, clear arrears, or settle the lease early here.

staff.label: Pay the supplier
staff.hint: The down payment has cleared, so the vehicle can be bought.

customer.label: We're buying your vehicle
customer.hint: Your down payment has cleared and we're paying the supplier.

staff.label: Lodge the CR with the DMT
staff.hint: The vehicle is bought. Register it with us as absolute owner.

customer.label: Registering your vehicle
customer.hint: We've bought it and are registering it with the DMT.

staff.label: Confirm the CR came back
staff.hint: Lodged with the DMT. Record the CR number once it's returned.

customer.label: Waiting on the DMT
customer.hint: Your registration is with the DMT. We'll start your rentals once the CR is back.

staff.label: Activate the lease
staff.hint: Title is registered to us. Activating generates the rental schedule and starts the term.

customer.label: Your lease is about to start
customer.hint: The vehicle is registered. We're setting up your rental schedule.

staff.label: Awaiting the down payment
staff.hintAmount: {{amount}} outstanding. The lessee can pay by card, or you can record an offline receipt.
staff.hintGeneric: The lessee needs to pay their down payment before we can buy the vehicle.

customer.label: Pay your down payment
customer.hint: We buy the vehicle once this clears. You can pay by card here.

staff.label: Awaiting the lessee's answer
staff.hint: Terms have been quoted. Nothing is payable until they accept.

customer.label: Review and accept your terms
customer.hint: Your rental, down payment and charges are ready. Nothing is payable until you accept.

staff.label: Issue the quotation
staff.hint: Approved — but nothing is payable until terms are quoted and accepted. The lessee is waiting on this.

customer.label: Your quotation is being prepared
customer.hint: You're approved. We're finalising your rental, down payment and charges.

staff.label: Waiting on the lessee
staff.hint: More information has been requested from them.

customer.label: We need more from you
customer.hint: Please upload the documents we've asked for so we can carry on.

staff.label: Get an independent valuation
staff.hint: A used or reconditioned vehicle can't be approved until one is back — LTV is measured against it.

customer.label: Your vehicle is being valued
customer.hint: An independent valuer needs to inspect it before we can decide.

staff.label: Make a credit decision
staff.hint: Everything needed is in. Approve, request more information, or decline.

customer.label: We're reviewing your application
customer.hint: We'll let you know as soon as there's a decision.
